title: Russian earthquake weapons could set off an earthquake at Yellowstone

tellings.quote: The Russians have earthquake weapons. They can cause an earthquake at Yellowstone that'll wipe out the center US.

plain: Russia supposedly has weapons that can cause earthquakes, and they could set one off at Yellowstone that would 'wipe out the center US.' Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, a foreign power could set off a natural disaster across the middle of the country.
